name: Reliance Industries Ltd
description: Conglomerate engaged in hydrocarbons exploration, refining, petrochemicals, telecommunications (Jio), and retail.
market_position: Market leader in Indian telecoms (Jio) and retail; global-scale refining complex in Jamnagar.
growth_factors: Expansion in 5G services, retail store footprint expansion, renewable green hydrogen & solar gigafactories.
major_risks: Volatile crude refining margins, capital expenditure overhang on green energy transition, regulatory scrutiny.

name: Tata Consultancy Services
description: Global leader in IT services, consulting, and business solutions with operations across 55 countries.
market_position: Second largest IT services provider globally by market cap, pristine AAA balance sheet and industry-best margins.
growth_factors: Adoption of enterprise Generative AI, cloud modernization deal wins, BFSI digital transformation rebound.
major_risks: Slowdown in US/European discretionary IT spending, wage inflation, client insourcing trends.

name: HDFC Bank Ltd
description: India's largest private sector bank offering retail, corporate, and wholesale banking and digital loans.
market_position: Dominant private sector lender with extensive national branch network and stellar asset quality track record.
growth_factors: Post-merger cross-selling synergies with HDFC Ltd mortgage portfolio, semi-urban & rural branch expansion.
major_risks: Margin compression due to high cost of deposits, regulatory changes in liquidity coverage ratios, credit slippages.

name: Infosys Ltd
description: Next-generation digital services and consulting firm delivering AI, cloud, and engineering services.
market_position: Top-tier global IT firm with strong presence in banking, retail, and manufacturing sectors.
growth_factors: Generative AI suite 'Topaz' monetization, large digital transformation deal momentum, strong shareholder returns.
major_risks: Delay in client project rollouts, margin pressure from competitive deal pricing, foreign exchange volatility.

name: Tata Motors Ltd
description: Multinational automotive company manufacturing passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and luxury SUVs (JLR).
market_position: Market leader in Indian commercial vehicles and electric passenger vehicles; global luxury footprint via JLR.
growth_factors: Rapid adoption of electric vehicles (EVs), turnaround in JLR order book for Range Rover & Defender models, debt reduction.
major_risks: Cyclical demand in commercial vehicles, global supply chain disruptions, rising raw material (steel, battery) costs.

name: ITC Ltd
description: Diversified conglomerate with leadership in cigarettes, FMCG, hotels, paperboards, and agribusiness.
market_position: Dominant tobacco market share, rapidly growing non-cigarette FMCG brands (Aashirvaad, Sunfeast, Bingo).
growth_factors: FMCG margin expansion, proposed demerger of hotel business to unlock value, robust free cash flow generation.
major_risks: Adverse taxation policies on tobacco products, inflationary pressures on agricultural raw materials.

name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd
description: Major technology, engineering, construction, manufacturing and financial services conglomerate.
market_position: India's premier infrastructure development and EPC contractor with marquee projects in India and Middle East.
growth_factors: Record infrastructure capex in India, Middle East energy & infrastructure expansion, green energy initiatives.
major_risks: Project execution delays, raw material price escalation, working capital intensity in international contracts.

name: Pidilite Industries
description: Pioneer in consumer adhesives, sealants, construction chemicals, and art materials (Fevicol, M-Seal, Dr. Fixit).
market_position: Virtually monopolistic consumer recall in wood adhesives and sealants across India.
growth_factors: Expansion in construction chemicals and paints, rural consumption growth, continuous product innovation.
major_risks: High dependence on vinyl acetate monomer (VAM) raw material prices, real estate construction slowdown.

name: Havells India Ltd
description: Fast moving electrical goods (FMEG) manufacturer producing cables, switchgears, lighting, and Lloyd appliances.
market_position: Top-tier domestic brand in consumer wires, cables, switchgears, and consumer appliances.
growth_factors: Real estate revival driving electrical fittings demand, Lloyd AC business turnaround, premiumization trend.
major_risks: Intense competition in room air conditioning and kitchen appliances, copper price volatility.

name: KPIT Technologies Ltd
description: Specialist software integration partner for automotive and mobility leaders building Autonomous, Connected, Electric vehicles.
market_position: Niche pure-play automotive software vendor with deep OEM client engagements across Europe and USA.
growth_factors: Software-defined vehicles (SDV) mega-trend, long-term strategic contracts with major automakers.
major_risks: High client concentration in top 5 auto OEMs, risk of OEM in-house software development initiatives.
